about: Guided tour. Each step: site (id in data/sites.json), title, text, optional date (slider position, YYYY-MM-DD), play_to (play the slider from date to this date), note (shown on the timeline), and change (a change id to open) or change_verdict (opens the largest change with that label). Steps whose site is not ready are skipped. Steps on a fake site (fixture: true) are stand-ins: they run only while no real site in this list is ready. Real-site dates and change ids get filled in when the data lands.

steps.title: Muhos, Finland
steps.text: Between March and August 2026, about 330 hectares of forest were cleared for a planned data centre, before the required environmental assessment was finished.

steps.title: The clearing continued
steps.text: In May the company was told an assessment was required. The clearing continued. Radar recorded each stage, in any weather.

steps.title: Agroparc Penedès, Catalonia
steps.text: Earthworks for a 258-hectare project. A court partly halted the works in July 2025; they continue today.
steps.note: July 2025: court partly halts the works

steps.title: All of Catalonia
steps.text: The same method across Catalonia: every change, sorted by how much it deserves a second look.

steps.title: The evidence behind a label
steps.text: Open any change to see the evidence and the records behind its label.

steps.title: A practice site
steps.text: Until the real places are ready, this tour runs on a made-up site. Each coloured shape is a place where the ground changed between satellite passes.

steps.title: Changes in the order they happened
steps.text: Watch the changes appear as the timeline moves. The background switches to the photo of each year, so you can see the land itself.
